chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Ayyub from Muhammad ibn Ziyad from Asbat ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When Amina bint Wahb went into labor and the pains of childbirth seized her for the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), Fatima bint Asad, the wife of Abu Talib, was present with her. She did not cease to be with her until she gave birth. Then one of them said to the other, 'Do you see what I see?' She said, 'And what do you see?' She said, 'This light that has shone between the East and the West.' While they were in that state, Abu Talib entered upon them and said to them both, 'What is the matter with you two? From what thing are you amazed?' So Fatima informed him of the light that she had seen. So Abu Talib said to her, 'Shall I not give you good tidings?' She said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Indeed, you will give birth to a boy who will be the successor (Wasi) of this newborn.'
ai.seo_question: What miraculous sign accompanied the birth of the Prophet Muhammad and what did Abu Talib prophesy about Fatima's son?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi highlights the spiritual kinship between the Prophet Muhammad and Imam Ali by linking their births through the miraculous light (Nur) witnessed by Fatima bint Asad. Abu Talib’s prophecy that Fatima will bear the Prophet’s successor (Wasi) serves as an early, explicit indication of Imam Ali’s designated role, reinforcing the Shia doctrine of Imamate and the continuity of divine guidance within the Ahl al-Bayt.
